relationships.subject: TRPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, TRP channel stimulation results in CGRP release, which can be activated or sensitized by various endogenous and exogenous stimuli

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: recent preclinical and clinical evidence has identified calcitonin gene related peptide (CGRP) as a major mediator of migraine pain

key_findings: TRP channels, mainly TRPA1, are expressed in sensory neurons and trigger CGRP release relevant to migraine.
Review proposes TRPA1 as a migraine treatment target.
